layout_runtime_source: Reorders existing/future sections and widgets by mutating only the existing sections/widgets arrays in the editor working copy
responsive_runtime_source: Third responsive test: 2 columns below 700px real panel width, 3 columns from 700-899px, and the validated 4 columns from 900px; legacy 520px may expand to 900px in tablet and 1000px on desktop
span_contract: below 700px span-2 remains full row; from 700px span-2 occupies 2 columns; kind-hero always occupies the full row
native_power_graph_contract: power-sources-graph remains outside metric-grid and full width; no internals are modified
migration: none; existing .storage configuration remains valid and is never rewritten by the responsive runtime
